title: Reliability, Craftsmanship, and Comfort
summary: Feedback centers on perceived reliability, interior craftsmanship, and comfort, with praise for dependable ownership impressions and cabin quality alongside a few concerns about reliability and traction behavior.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise reliability, comfort, interior craftsmanship, and the overall blend of safety, luxury, and usability.

negative.summary: Negative reviews cite unreliability in general and unstable rear grip in rain when applying power.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention improving quality and reliability or refer briefly to craftsmanship and package appeal without enough context for clear sentiment.

limitations: Several sampled fragments are very short or lack context, which limits precise interpretation.
Some assigned positive examples contain concern-oriented wording, so sentiment labels and fragment wording are not always aligned.
The topic blends multiple aspects—reliability, craftsmanship, comfort, and tech connection reliability—rather than one single issue.
